Messages.Author: mostly harmless
Messages.Body:
From the card text on Bauble:

"[vic] +1 stealth action. Put this card on the acting vampire. Search
your library and put a non-unique, non-location equipment card on
another minion you control..."

So my question is: When I play Bauble, do I *have* to take the
equipment out of my library or can I use an equipment card from my
hand as well?

Michael

Hm. I think the card text itself is not that clear (hence my initial
question). The card doesn't say:"search your library for an equipment card
and put it on another ready minion.". It merely tells you to search your
library and put an equipment card on a minion, it doesn't explicitly say if
that equipment card has to come from your library. The way I see it, the
card text could be interpreted in different ways.

if card text confines you to only searching your library, that should be
sufficient.

would you argue that since the card text does not explicitly say to equip
the equipment found in the library that it can *only* be a piece of
equipment from your hand or other source?

it doesn't explicitly say the you *could* equip it if you found it in your
library, it just says search, so what we have is a 2 blood costing card that
lets you look through your library. and as a side effect equip a piece of
equipment from your hand. which is not the case.
